The fixture `tabular_zm_1_2026.pdf` is the public, unmodified PDF from
https://www.litovel.eu/filemanager/files/file.php?file=5228013.

It contains 12 adopted resolutions from Litovel's council meeting on
2 November 2026, numbered `UZ-1-1/26` through `UZ-12-1/26`.
The three-page table includes overlaid bold characters and separate voting,
responsibility, deadline and completion columns. Its footer contains a different
date, so the parser must use the meeting-date column.
